description: backend.rs line 88: with_properties(mut self, props: Vec<String>) forces every callsite to allocate a Vec<String> for single-property errors: vec!["name".to_owned()], vec!["role".to_owned()] etc. This appears 6+ times across mailbox.rs and submission.rs. with_description already uses impl Into<String> for ergonomics — with_properties should use impl Into<Vec<String>> or accept &[impl AsRef<str>] consistently. The current API causes unnecessary heap allocations on every set-error path and requires callers to remember .to_owned() for string literals. Maintainability impact: every new handler must repeat the same boilerplate.
title: SetError::with_properties takes Vec<String> — ergonomics inconsistency with with_description
